profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at SeatGeek
profile.summary: Highly motivated Senior Software Engineer who excels in autonomous work, proactively identifying areas for improvement and independently driving their execution. Proven ability to reduce technical debt and consistently deliver high-quality solutions with tangible impact.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Kubernetes · Technical Design · Scala · Google BigQuery · Google Cloud Run · Database Design · Technical Architecture · Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Python (Programming Language) · Kubernetes · Scala · Google BigQuery · Technical Documentation · Google Cloud Run

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Modeled AWS resource usage (EBS, EC2, RDS) through workload profiling and daily analysis of four months of resource utilization data
• Rewrote a legacy Python API in Go to support real-time usage analytics and enterprise-grade system integration
• Improved historical processing capabilities by extending the job scheduler to backfill over 12 months of platform data
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Development · Terraform · TypeScript · Amazon EBS · Cloud Computing · REST APIs · Google Docs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · JavaScript · Amazon CloudWatch · Databases · Node.js · Jira · Google Sheets · Code Review · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Conducted research on physician v non-physician use of a medical diagnostic tool using NASA archival data
• Questioned how physicians and non physicians spend their time differently when navigating the Clinical Outcome Metrics for Optimization of Robust Training (COMfORT) diagnostic aid
• Formed conclusions on how diagnostic aids can be better supported for non physician use
• Presented findings at the 2019 North Carolina Cognition Conference

positions.title: Technology Intern Program
positions.description:
• Explored various services within AWS such as Cloudwatch Events, DynamoDB, and Elastic File System
• Developed three particles for the Particle Cloud Framework, an open source cloud resource provisioning framework 
• Automated the installing of Docker to deploy Apache Airflow using an EC2 instance
positions.insights: Skills: Application Programming Interfaces (API) · Python (Programming Language) · Agile Development · Terraform · Amazon EBS · Cloud Computing · REST APIs · Google Docs · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Jira · Code Review · Amazon EC2

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Updated APTest sessions through Jenkins to provide quicker status updates for release deploys
• Implemented automation to allow for quicker testing of different communication plans
• Used Ruby on Rails to update Cisco Jasper Control Center interface
• Using Raspberry Pi, explored and presented on the Internet of Things in a way that was relatable and understandable
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Development · REST APIs · Google Docs

positions.title: Assistant Team Lead
positions.description:
• Educated over sixty students from 3rd to 8th grade about the engineering design process
• Presented students with engineering projects that incited creativity as well as constraints that required them to think outside of the box
• Explained complicated engineering concepts to younger students in a way that was understandable and engaging

positions.title: Sales Associate
positions.description:
• Processed customer transactions, collected payments, and distributed change
• Handled customer inquires to ensure a smooth shopping experience
• Performed inventory checks of merchandise

honors.title: Goodnight Scholarship
